• It refers to the measures taken by the central bank of a country to regulate the supply of money and credit in the economy.
 
• The general target of the monetary policy is to ensure price stability in the economy.
 
• This means that the central bank aims to keep inflation low and stable, so that prices of goods and services do not fluctuate too much.
 
 
 
• **Inflation**:-
 
 
• It is a key concern for any economy, as it erodes the purchasing power of money and makes it difficult for people to plan their finances.
 
• The central bank uses various tools such as interest rates, reserve requirements, and open market operations to influence the supply of money and credit in the economy and keep inflation in check.
